headline: MCC Law 41.16 — a reminder, not a change
summary: The non-striker run-out has sat under Run Out, not Unfair Play, since 2022 — still catching people out in dispute chat.
detail: Since the 2017 Code (3rd edition, 2022 amendment), Law 41.16 classifies this dismissal as a standard Run Out. It carries no special reporting requirement and is not considered unfair play.

headline: ECB Premier Cricket — 2026 conditions now live
summary: Updated ball-change and over-rate clauses for the new season, in the ECB Premier Cricket ruleset.
detail: The 2026 playing conditions clarify the over-rate penalty as a points deduction rather than a fine, and confirm ball-change decisions rest with the umpires rather than either captain.
